environment.description: AWS Lambda behind Application Load Balancer with HTTPS:443 listener configured with mutual TLS authentication. The ALB listener has 'MutualAuthentication' attribute set with Mode=verify, TrustStoreArn pointing to an ACM PCA-issued trust store (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:XXXX:truststore/internal-ca-store/abc123). The trust store contains only the intermediate CA certificate issued by a private ACM PCA (arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:XXXX:certificate-authority/internal-services-ca). Client certificates are provisioned exclusively through an internal PKI enrollment service that issues short-lived certs (4hr TTL) to authenticated service principals via STS AssumeRole with ExternalId. The ALB connection-level mTLS verification occurs at the TLS handshake layer before any HTTP request bytes are processed by the target Lambda. Connections failing client certificate verification receive TLS alert 'certificate_required' (alert 116) and the TCP connection is reset without forwarding. Additionally, the ALB access logs show the client certificate DN in the 'ssl_client_cert_subject' field for audit. Security group restricts inbound to VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 only.

config.trust_store_ca: ACM PCA intermediate CA (internal-services-ca), 4hr client cert TTL
config.mtls_failure_behavior: TLS handshake rejection (alert 116), no HTTP forwarding
